title: Browns OC Travis Switzer: Deshaun Watson has to be part of equation in QB competition

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Browns OC Travis Switzer: Deshaun Watson has to be part of equation in QB competition
sources.description: Browns offensive coordinator Travis Switzer isn't sharing any hints about who the team's quarterback will be come September, but he said on Wednesday that it will be just fine with him if it is one of the options already on the roster.
